name: SCP: Anomaly Site
desc:
WELCOME TO SCP: ANOMALY SITE! 🎉

Play as Scientist, Security, MTF, or Director: study strange creatures called SCPs and keep them contained.
Play as D-Class or Chaos Insurgency: escape the site, fight the SCP Foundation, and launch a nuclear warhead.
